record.original_question: For which fibred knots K1 and K2 are the product symplectic manifolds (X_Ki × S^2, omega_Ki + omega_S^2) symplectomorphic, where X_Ki is the K3 knot-surgery manifold associated with K_i?

evidence.quote: For which fibred knots K1, K2 are (XKi × S2, ωKi + ωS2 ) symplectomorphic?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ denote the K3 surface, equipped with a Kähler symplectic form, and let $T \subset X$ be a smoothly embedded symplectic torus of self-intersection $0$ representing a primitive homology class (for instance, a smooth fiber of an elliptic fibration on $X$). For a knot $K \subset S^3$, the Fintushel–Stern knot surgery manifold is defined by
$$X_K \;=\; \bigl(X \setminus \nu(T)\bigr) \,\cup_{\partial}\, \bigl((S^1 \times (S^3 \setminus \nu(K))\bigr),$$
where the gluing is performed so that $\{\mathrm{pt}\}\times \mu(K)$ is identified with the boundary of a normal disk to $T$, and $\mu(K)$ denotes the meridian of $K$. When $K$ is a fibred knot, $X_K$ admits a canonical symplectic form $\omega_K$ obtained by gluing the symplectic form on $X \setminus \nu(T)$ with the symplectic form on $S^1 \times M_K$, where $M_K$ is the mapping torus of the monodromy of the fibration $S^3 \setminus \nu(K) \to S^1$.

Endow $S^2$ with its standard symplectic (area) form $\omega_{S^2}$, and consider the product symplectic 6-manifolds
$$\bigl(X_{K_i} \times S^2,\; \omega_{K_i} \oplus \omega_{S^2}\bigr), \qquad i = 1, 2.$$

Determine, for which pairs of fibred knots $K_1, K_2 \subset S^3$, the symplectic 6-manifolds $(X_{K_1} \times S^2,\, \omega_{K_1} \oplus \omega_{S^2})$ and $(X_{K_2} \times S^2,\, \omega_{K_2} \oplus \omega_{S^2})$ are symplectomorphic.
artifact.status_search_result: A literature search reveals work on smooth stabilization of Fintushel–Stern knot surgery manifolds (e.g., Akbulut–Auckly type results showing $X_K \# (S^2 \times S^2)$ becomes independent of $K$) and on symplectic Lefschetz fibration structures on $X_K$ for fibred $K$, but no result was located addressing symplectomorphism type of the products $X_K \times S^2$ with the product symplectic form. The question appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: On dissolving knot surgery 4-manifolds under a CP^2-connected sum
status_evidence.snippet: Studies smooth stabilization of knot surgery 4-manifolds X_K, indicating that smooth stabilization questions are still actively studied; symplectic version with S^2 factor not addressed.
status_evidence.claim: Smooth stabilization of X_K is studied but symplectic stabilization by S^2 is not resolved here.

status_evidence.title: Knotted surfaces in 4-manifolds by Knot surgery and Stabilization
status_evidence.snippet: Surface knots constructed by knot surgery become pairwise diffeomorphic after one stabilization; addresses smooth rather than symplectic category.
status_evidence.claim: Smooth stabilization results exist; symplectic analog for X_K × S^2 not established.
